_note: Police (docs/police_spec.md, Tim settled 2026-10-18). Tiers by clan heat; officers per tier come out of the police HQ. Seconds and world units; numbers are defaults to tune in playtests. hunt: fighting = go for the clan's units seen fighting within sight; hero = a squad hunts the hero; all = hunt hero and crew. Police knock the hero down and arrest him (arrestSeconds channel, only his crew can break it by hitting the officer); he then stands greyed out at the HQ for heroJailSeconds and the clan's heat drops to heroJailHeat (Tim 2026-10-18). Bribe at the police box: bribeHeat off for bribePerTier x (tier + 1) ryo. No bribe if an officer hit the hero in the last bribeBlockSeconds. A knocked-out officer is replaced after replaceSeconds, out of the HQ or the box; the replacement patrols and only joins a hunt once it sees the hero itself (Most Wanted: at once). clinicScale applies from tier clinicScaleFrom (Wanted), payouts cut from payoutCutFrom (Manhunt). noPoliceAreas: [minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ] boxes (the forest outskirts, when the map has them). Infamy = lifetime heat until the infamy board exists. Lost him (Tim 2026-10-18): no radios: each officer only knows where the hero is while it sees him (sight) or sees another officer chasing him (within sight), and for lostSeconds after, never indoors; then they search that spot (searchRadius) for searchSeconds and go back to patrolling: they walk round the clan's last fight while it is under patrolFightSeconds old (and not one they already searched past), otherwise they wander the streets from where they are, patrolRadius steps a leg (Tim 2026-10-18: no more waiting outside the door he went into). Arrested crew stay in jail until bailed out at the HQ, no time limit (Tim 2026-10-18). relentless (Most Wanted, 120+): they always know where he is, never give up and follow him indoors.
